provenance: synthetic teaching cases, not runtime observations
capability: fixed restricted-compatible workload; separate host admission/runtime identity checks

cases.task: Explain UID, capabilities, privilege escalation, seccomp and root filesystem fields.
cases.expected: Each field is connected to its specific mechanism rather than one generic secure label.

cases.task: Use the fixed nonroot source in a qualified operation.
cases.expected: Accepted source, observed workload readiness and owned cleanup are recorded.

cases.task: In a scratch copy of the starter, change allowPrivilegeEscalation to true or add privileged: true.
cases.expected: The course parser refuses the source before any cluster request. Under Pod Security Admission, privileged: true violates the Baseline level and allowPrivilegeEscalation: true violates the Restricted level.

cases.task: Review hostPath, hostNetwork and hostPID variants.
cases.expected: hostPath volumes, hostNetwork and hostPID violate the Baseline standard, so a namespace enforcing baseline or restricted rejects them at admission; the classroom parser rejects them even earlier.

cases.task: With a policy-qualified host fixture, compare allowed and denied API requests.
cases.expected: Policy version, namespace UID and actual admission reason accompany the result.

cases.task: Describe what the fixed controls address and one remaining boundary requiring another control.
cases.expected: For example, RBAC controls API access while network policy or application auth addresses different paths.
